name: Example
overview: Scripture calls believers to live as holy examples by reflecting the character of God, who is holy and commands His people to sanctify themselves and avoid defiling practices (Leviticus 11:44; 19:2). The people of Israel are instructed not to follow the sinful customs of surrounding nations, highlighting the importance of distinctiveness in conduct (Leviticus 20:23; Deuteronomy 18:9). Additionally, leadership by example is emphasized through acts of justice and care for others, as seen in Nehemiah's appeal to redeem and protect brethren from oppression (Nehemiah 5:8). Together, these verses underscore the call to lead and live by godly example, grounded in the holiness of God.
